neighbours.label: the standard of comparison after 'than' or 'as ... as' (than ours, as anywhere, than kids did in 1977)
fire: Their winters are much colder than ours in the north.
Rents in this town are as high as anywhere in the country.
Teenagers today sleep less than their parents did at that age.
Her garden is greener than the garden of the house next door.
Coffee here costs twice as much as in Rome.
The new phone is faster than the old one was.
Our team trained harder this season than theirs.
Crime is lower today than it was in the nineties.
quiet: Their winters are long and dark in the north.
Rents in this town have risen every year since 2010.
Teenagers today sleep with their phones beside the bed.
Her garden is full of roses and lavender in June.
Coffee here is served with a small glass of water.
The new phone has a larger screen and a better camera.
Our team trained every morning this season.
Crime is a major topic in the local elections.

notes: Probes: 'than ours' 0.63, 'as anywhere else' 0.88, 'than kids did' 0.69, 'than the car of my neighbour' 1.04; 'as tall as their flowers' 0.02 (that type belongs to the + pole).
